svg.title: v1 vs v2 running the whole mission (replay)

g.desc: Animated replay at 30x speed of both controllers running the whole mission on the robot model with motor lag and wheel slip. v1 (original): 2/5 jars, stuck from 412 s. v2 (improved): 5/5 jars, done at 864 s.

svg.text: Robot model with motor lag and wheel slip; v1 is a line-for-line port of the original. Generated by tools/MissionReplay.java.
